questions.question: Which statement best describes AI?
options: [A] AI is exactly the same as normal computer programming
[B] AI enables machines to perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence
[C] AI only works with mathematical calculations
[D] AI cannot learn or improve over time
questions.answer: [B] AI enables machines to perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence

questions.question: AI can help schools by:
options: [B] Personalizing learning experiences and managing administrative tasks
questions.answer: [B] Personalizing learning experiences and managing administrative tasks

questions.question: Voice assistants like Siri or Alexa are best classified as:
Which of the following is NOT presented as a core objective/ability associated with AI in the video?
options: [D] Guaranteeing human-like emotions in all systems
questions.answer: [D] Guaranteeing human-like emotions in all systems

questions.question: Which of the following best highlights the difference between AI and traditional programming?
options: [A] Traditional programming always uses cloud computing, AI doesn't
[B] Traditional programming is based on fixed rules, while AI adapts and learns from data
[C] AI doesn't require data, unlike traditional programming
[D] Both work exactly the same way but use different names
questions.answer: [B] Traditional programming is based on fixed rules, while AI adapts and learns from data

questions.question: What is the primary goal of consumer Gen AI applications?
options: [B] Provide a complex API for developers
[C] Deliver a user-friendly interface for easy consumption
questions.answer: [C] Deliver a user-friendly interface for easy consumption

questions.question: Which AI application mentioned in the video helps people with physical disabilities?
A school district pilots an AI tutor that adapts lessons to each learner. What is the primary benefit and the primary risk to watch?
options: [A] Benefit: one-size-fits-all pacing; Risk: model transparency
[B] Benefit: personalized learning; Risk: student data privacy and security
[C] Benefit: guaranteed fairness; Risk: higher teacher workload
[D] Benefit: eliminates homework; Risk: slow grading
questions.answer: [B] Benefit: personalized learning; Risk: student data privacy and security
